description: Synthetic evaluation seed for the Raman-Ellis family covering 2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31 (America/Los_Angeles): Priya's year on the Individual plan, the family's 2026 on the Family plan (the fixture history, verbatim), and the shows' episodes on their schedules through December 2026. Loadable with env.load_seed at any clock in the window; Tidepool shows only records dated at or before the clock.

sources.description: Original fictional text authored for this package by @byshail. All artists, albums, tracks, shows, episodes, people, devices and prices are invented; no external catalogs, recordings, show notes or listening data were collected, translated or adapted.

Template-generated fictional episodes, listening sessions, payments and one notice written by dev/build-dataset.cjs on the fixture schedules. Shows, artists, albums, tracks and people are the fixture's; guests and narrators are invented personal names; nothing was collected from real services.

transformations: Every fixture record is copied verbatim except three that the 2025 story extends: family.created_at and Priya's joined_at move to 2025-01-03 (the account opens on the Individual plan), and billing gains an Individual start on 2025-01-03 before the fixture's Family entry, which becomes an upgrade at the Jan. 3, 2026 renewal. The billing calendar (the 3rd of each month, 00:00 PST) and every 2026 invoice are unchanged. The upgrade carries no proration, as the fixture's paid 1799-cent February invoice requires; plan.confirm_change at exactly 00:00 on Jan. 3 would add 700 cents (it prorates the whole new period), one minute earlier 0.
Priya's 2025 sessions are expanded from weekly routines with a fixed random seed; her 2025 progress and play counts are derived from them and share no key with the fixture's.
Episodes extend each show's fixture cadence backwards to 2025-01-01 and forwards to 2026-12-31; Field Notes stops at 114 so that examples/events/fieldnotes-115-publish.json still applies.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation, name collisions with real products and reuse permissions.
